purpose: Expose the already-working Grave, Vascular, and Silt return consequences as one canonical Host recomposition read without changing route gameplay or progression authority.
acceptance: Hub publishes all three retained readings through one read-only returnedReadings surface.
Destination readiness telemetry reports the actual pending/available route instead of defaulting to Grave.
Silt runtime compatibility metadata resolves to CELL_SILT_PRESSURE_ROUTE_001.
Return recomposition telemetry changes only when the retained-reading set changes.
Neighbor gameplay owners remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
